title: Generative AI for Python Automation Testing
overview: This course is designed for QA engineers, test automation developers, and software testers who want to leverage Generative AI for enhanced test case generation, automation scripting, debugging, and test optimization.
AI-powered test case generation and automation
Using AI to improve Selenium, Py-Test, and Robot Framework scripts
Automating test data generation and edge case handling
AI-driven defect analysis and debugging assistance
Enhancing CI/CD pipelines with AI-powered testing
By the end of the course, testers will be able to use Generative AI to enhance automation testing workflows, improve test efficiency, and detect defects faster.
methodology: This course follows a hands-on, practical approach, including:
Hands-on coding exercises with AI-powered test automation
Live demonstrations of AI-enhanced testing workflows
Capstone project: AI-powered automated testing framework
competencies: By the end of the course, participants will:
Use AI for automated test case generation and script optimization
Leverage Generative AI for debugging and defect analysis
Automate test data creation with AI-based techniques
Integrate AI-powered automation testing into CI/CD pipelines
Improve test coverage, efficiency, and accuracy using AI
objectivesIntro: Upon completing the course, participants will:
objectives: Develop AI-driven test case generation strategies
Use Generative AI for improving automation scripts in Python
Enhance debugging and defect detection with AI tools
Integrate AI-powered testing into DevOps workflows
Ensure comprehensive test coverage with AI-enhanced automation
